settings.startIntro: By default, Nacre opens a new tab. Previous pages are not restored.

settings.fontSizeNote: Does not change the typography set by websites.
settings.bookmarksLocal: Saved bookmarks stay local to Nacre.

settings.searchNote: The engine receives the search you enter. Automatic suggestions are disabled.
settings.httpsOnlyNote: Blocks HTTP and shows a warning before continuing.
settings.antiFingerprintNote: Partial Canvas and Web Audio guards are configured. OffscreenCanvas, workers and some frame realms are not protected; this status does not certify effective Canvas protection or anonymity.
settings.webglNote: Nacre passes --disable-3d-apis and --disable-webgl to Chromium before startup. BrowserLeaks previously identified the graphics card in an earlier version; the effect of these options must be checked after installation. If WebGL remains available, the mitigation failed. 3D sites may not work.
settings.cookiePolicyNote: Network headers and direct JavaScript access in blocked frames are guarded. Native cookie writes are conservatively purged. Worker reads and borrowed native accessors are not fully covered.
settings.sendGpcNote: Enabled by default; asks sites to respect your privacy preference.
settings.sendDntNote: Disabled by default: DNT is rare and may help distinguish your browser.
settings.clearOnQuitNote: Removes cookies, authentication, web cache, IndexedDB, local storage, file systems, and service workers from the normal profile. Enabled by default for new profiles; existing profiles keep their choice. Bookmarks and settings are retained.
settings.clearSiteData: Local storage, IndexedDB, file systems, service workers, and site data
settings.clearFilterCache: Downloaded filter cache (rules and lists remain in settings)
settings.clearPeriodNote: Period: all available time. Electron does not allow selecting a shorter period for this data.
settings.adblockIntro: Network and cosmetic filtering with open lists. The counter remains in memory only, and blocking applies to normal and private sessions.
settings.adblockEnabledNote: Blocks known requests and hides elements covered by the rules.
settings.adblockStrict: Strict · also blocks third-party scripts and iframes
settings.adblockModeNote: Strict mode may break sign-in or site functionality.
settings.adblockWeeklyNote: Disabled by default. Runs only when Tor is connected; no direct fallback.
settings.customListNote: HTTPS requests are allowed only when Tor is connected; the provider sees the requested list and Tor exit IP. Effective routing still requires packet-capture verification. A third-party list controls its rules and may break sites. Filters are parsed, not executed as code; only scriptlets built into Nacre and approved by Nacre can run.
settings.customFiltersNote: Network and cosmetic rules compatible with uBlock/Adblock Plus-style syntax.
settings.siteExceptionsNote: The address-bar shield can also disable filters on the open site.
settings.adblockPrivacyNote: Updates run only when Tor is ready; providers see the exit address and requested lists. Actual routing still needs packet-capture verification. No Nacre identifier or browsing URL is intentionally sent. ClearURLs is not enabled; AdGuard filters are excluded until licensing and syntax are verified.
settings.adblockLicenseNote: uBlock Origin and EasyList lists may carry GPLv3/CC BY-SA obligations depending on sources and versions; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md before redistribution.
settings.torNetworkNote: Tor routes only Nacre traffic. It is not a system VPN. By default, your ISP sees a connection to the Tor network; it may also see timing and volume.
settings.navigatorLocaleNote: Pages and iframes use en-US/UTC in tests. navigator.languages still differs in some workers; do not consider all language surfaces identical.
settings.bridgeNone: No bridge (direct connection to the Tor network)
settings.bridgeNote: obfs4 and Snowflake are provided by Lyrebird in the Tor bundle. If the next field is empty, Nacre uses the bundle's public lines; they may become outdated.
settings.customBridgeNote: One line per bridge, up to 8. “Custom bridges” requires valid lines. Changes apply the next time Tor connects.
settings.torPrivacyNote: A site normally sees the Tor exit relay IP address. Your ISP and the first relay still know your origin IP. Some sites block Tor. Snowflake also contacts its broker and STUN/WebRTC servers; Snowflake volunteers relay encrypted data intended for the Tor network, not your traffic in clear text.
settings.directMode: Direct connection — your ISP can see your traffic
settings.directModeNote: Direct mode: sites receive your public IP and your ISP may observe destination IPs and metadata. Chromium secure DNS is configured, but absence of system DNS fallback and ECH have not been verified by packet capture.
settings.filterStatusLoaded: Ghostery engine loaded · versioned snapshot · last checked: {date}
settings.webglRuntime: Local Chromium test: no WebGL context was detected in the page, an iframe, or the three tested worker types. Check browserleaks.com/webgl after installation to confirm the result in this site.
settings.torUnavailableBlocked: Tor unavailable · traffic blocked (IPv6 socket measurements unverified)
settings.directConnected: Direct connection · your ISP can see your traffic
settings.filterBundledActive: Included in bundled snapshot · always active
settings.filterWaitingTor: Waiting for Tor download · use “Update lists”
settings.filterDownloadingTor: Downloading through the active Tor session… If Tor stops, no direct request will be attempted.

settings.filterFailedClosed: Fail closed: the bundled version remains active.

settings.webrtcTor: unproxied UDP blocked by Chromium policy; preload API removal is incomplete
settings.connectTorFirst: Connect Tor to check versions; no direct request will be sent.
settings.releaseUpdateAvailable: {label} {current} → {latest} available. Manual download and installation required.
settings.releaseUpToDate: {label} {current} · current according to the latest published release ({latest}).
settings.askDownloadLocation: Ask where to save each file
settings.askDownloadNote: A chooser window opens before the transfer.
settings.openDownloadsNote: Windows opens non-executable files. Executables require confirmation each time before opening.
settings.downloadPrivacyNote: The full file path is not sent to pages. Executables, scripts, and command files are paused and require confirmation before download and before opening. A file saved to disk remains after a private tab closes; closing that tab cancels its active transfers and clears its download entry.
settings.profileLocationNote: In portable mode, the profile is created in NacreData next to Nacre.exe. You can choose another folder. The change applies at the next startup and creates a fresh profile: Nacre does not copy or delete the existing profile. The chosen path is stored in a small local settings file.
settings.aboutIntro: Nacre does not persist browsing history, but keeps up to eight recently closed tabs in memory. Cookies, cache, and site storage in the normal profile persist unless you clear them or enable “Clear site data on close”. Downloaded files and recently closed tabs are not removed automatically.
settings.updatesNote: Manual check for Nacre and Electron versions via Tor only; nothing installs automatically.
settings.releaseRepository: Public GitHub repository for Nacre releases
settings.releaseRepositoryNote: Leave blank if Nacre has no public repository with published releases. Example: organization/nacre.
settings.updatesPrivacyNote: Checks are available only when Tor is connected. GitHub receives the requested repository name and Tor exit address, not your history, bookmarks, or visited URLs. Nothing downloads or installs automatically.
settings.netlogNote: The Electron fixture NetLog observed a Chromium IPv6 UDP attempt to [2001:4860:4860::8888]:443, including with local SOCKS and a closed proxy. It does not prove packets were actually sent on the Windows interface. The absence of parallel output in the installed app is therefore unverified.
settings.blockTrackersNote: Local filtering of major tracking domains
settings.blockThirdPartyCookiesNote: Cookies removed from detected cross-site exchanges
settings.panelGpcNote: Asks sites not to sell your data
settings.torCardNote: Choose a country and turn the relay on or off directly from the top bar.
settings.torCountryNote: Sites will see a Tor relay IP address. The exit country used may differ from the requested country. This does not change the IP used by other Windows apps. Some sites may show CAPTCHAs or block Tor.
settings.proxyNote: Tor is a relay network, not a VPN. It hides your origin IP from the site, but not from applications outside Nacre. The connection may be slower. An exit relay may see domains and unencrypted traffic; HTTPS protects page content. Direct WebRTC UDP is blocked to limit IP leaks.
settings.panelClearSitesNote: Cookies and cache cleared on close
settings.panelPrivacyNote: Nacre does not persist browsing history. Your chosen search engine receives your searches. Without a relay, sites see your connection IP; with Tor or a proxy active, they normally see the exit address. Tor may slow browsing and some sites block it.
about.paragraphOne: Nacre has no account, sync, or analytics tool. No history is written to disk; the last normal tab closed remains temporarily in memory for Ctrl+Shift+T. Settings and bookmarks stay in the app's local folder.
about.paragraphTwo: Built-in protections block a list of known tracking domains, filter identifiable third-party cookies, and send the Global Privacy Control signal. They cannot hide your identity from a site where you sign in or replace regular updates to a browser maintained at large scale.

dashboard.title: Privacy dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your network route, protection settings and blocked requests in one place.
dashboard.routeScope: A requested country is not a verified exit location. This status does not prove the absence of IP, DNS or WebRTC leaks.
dashboard.blockedDetail: Network requests matched by loaded rules, not unique trackers.
dashboard.sitesDetail: Distinct site hostnames in the available session counters.
dashboard.protectionsDetail: Settings describe the configured policy. Coverage limits are shown beside each protection.
dashboard.typesDetail: Resource types come from Chromium. A rule match does not always distinguish advertising from tracking.
dashboard.bySiteDetail: Up to 20 sites with the most blocked requests. Counters contain hostnames only, without page paths or URL parameters.
dashboard.footer: Counters stay in memory for this session and are not sent anywhere. Clearing them does not clear browsing data or change protections. Private browsing counters are excluded.
dashboard.engineExceptionsUnknown: Blocking enabled; site exceptions are not reported.
dashboard.routeTorDetail: The Tor runtime reports ready. Exit details below are observations, not a network leak test.
dashboard.routeConnectingDetail: Tor is starting or changing identity. A working exit has not been confirmed here.
dashboard.routeNotReadyDetail: Tor is selected but its runtime is not ready. A usable exit has not been confirmed.
dashboard.routeBlockedDetail: The session reports a Tor error or a blocked route. Check the network settings.
dashboard.routeUnknownDetail: Route readiness is not reported. Connectivity and exit location are unknown.
dashboard.routeDirectDetail: Direct routing is selected. Tor is not providing this connection.
dashboard.routeManualDetail: A manual proxy is configured. Its connectivity and privacy are not verified here.
dashboard.routeSystemDetail: System routing mode is reported. Runtime connectivity is not verified here.
dashboard.filterDetail: Loaded rules can block matching network requests. Site exceptions may pause blocking; a blocked request is not a unique tracker.
dashboard.cookieDetail: Network headers and direct JavaScript access in blocked frames are guarded. Native cookie writes are conservatively purged. Worker reads and borrowed native accessors are not fully covered.
dashboard.fingerprintDetail: Partial Canvas and Web Audio guards are configured. OffscreenCanvas, workers and some frame realms are not protected; this status does not certify effective Canvas protection or anonymity.
dashboard.webglDetail: The configured WebGL policy is shown here. Use the privacy tests to check the exposed page APIs.
dashboard.httpsDetail: Controls HTTP navigation warnings. HTTPS means encrypted transport with an accepted certificate; it does not establish anonymity.
dashboard.signalsDetail: These request signals express your preference. Sites decide whether to honor them.
dashboard.webrtcDetail: This dashboard does not measure network leaks or run packet capture. Local privacy tests can inspect page APIs but cannot prove that all traffic stays on the intended route.
dashboard.typesEmpty: No blocked requests in the available session counters.
dashboard.sitesEmpty: Sites will appear when their requests are blocked.
dashboard.clearFailed: Could not clear the counters. Try again.
dashboard.clearUnconfirmed: Clear request sent; the updated counters have not been confirmed.

ui.bookmarkshtml.text7dcfcc39a4: Edit titles, addresses and folders. Drag and drop to reorder. Private bookmarks are not added to the normal profile.
ui.downloadshtml.textd0a0812f85: The list remains in memory until Nacre is closed. Files already downloaded remain in the chosen folder, including those downloaded from a private tab.
ui.httpauthhtml.text1c659f4c6c: Closing this window cancels sign-in. Credentials are not saved.
ui.leaktestshtml.textb71a39d59f: Third-party testing sites receive their requests and the information they test, including IP address, browser and fingerprint characteristics. Nacre does not collect or certify their results. The notes below remain on this page and disappear when you close it.
ui.leaktestshtml.text240e0af28c: Turn on Tor before testing. The official test should confirm that Tor is in use. Compare the exit address with the one displayed in the Tor menu.
ui.leaktestshtml.textd8e91c95ed: Check that no unexpected real or local IP addresses appear. RTCPeerConnection may remain available; Nacre enforces the Chromium policy that blocks unrelayed UDP when Tor is active.
ui.leaktestshtml.text3f54b45c89: Fingerprint: JavaScript, language and time zone
ui.leaktestshtml.text6e22febf35: Opens browserleaks.com/javascript with Tor active. In the page and iframes, expected: navigator.language en-US, navigator.languages en-US/en, Intl locale en-US, timeZone UTC, Coordinated Universal Time, offset 0, and Date formats in US English. The Chromium smoke confirms Date/Intl/UTC in the three workers tested, but navigator.languages still differs: Worker en-US/fr-FR; SharedWorker and ServiceWorker en-US only. Retest after installation and consider the list of worker languages as a known limit.
ui.leaktestshtml.text7eac89bfbd: Open browserleaks.com/webgl after installation then restart Nacre. Expected result: WebGL and WebGL 2 unavailable, and no card brand or model. Smoke runtime Electron 44.7.0 / Chromium 152 checked for absence of context WebGL in page, iframe, Worker, SharedWorker and ServiceWorker. The BrowserLeaks site has not yet been replayed on this installer: validate the result here after installation. 3D sites may no longer work.
ui.leaktestshtml.text689b4ec389: Open browserleaks.com/canvas. Partial coverage: OffscreenCanvas, workers and certain frame contexts are not protected. This setting does not certify effective Canvas protection. On supported surfaces, the Canvas hash remains the same when repeating the test in the same domain and session; it should vary on another domain and after restarting Nacre. The mechanism creates a random secret per session, derives it per registrable domain with HMAC-SHA256, and adds deterministic noise to the serialized pixels. Automated tests check simulated buffers, not the score of this third party site; Canvas/Audio/WebGL variations may disrupt applications.
ui.leaktestshtml.text0cfc3966ba: Open browserleaks.com/fonts and compare the results with your stable Chrome from the same PC, on the same system profile. Nacre does not forge a PDF list: Chromium itself provides navigator.plugins and mimeTypes, with PDF reader support enabled. Expected result: no Nacre list invented; Values reflect on-board Chromium and may differ from your Chrome. The exact console outputs announced in the request were not included (the received text only contained a placeholder), and therefore were not checked for equality.
ui.leaktestshtml.text906e95443f: In a new profile, manually enter a known address in http://: Nacre must display the local warning before navigation. Cancel, then choose “Continue Anyway” to check for the one-time exception. An HTTP redirect should also show the warning. With Tor enabled, stop tor.exe: pages should fail and no sessions should return to direct connection. Automated configuration test simulates closed proxy route; only real traffic testing on Windows can verify Chromium processes and transports as a whole.
ui.leaktestshtml.texta4d8519940: Open Cover Your Tracks and compare it to real Chrome installed on the same PC. The expected User-Agent is standard Chrome reduced to Chrome/<major>.0.0.0; it must not contain Nacre or Electron. Client Hints should include Google Chrome, formFactors Desktop, and navigator.languages should display en-US then en. PDF plugins now come from the embedded Chromium, not from a list invented by Nacre. Score and uniqueness vary with other features; a good result does not prove anonymity.
ui.leaktestshtml.text02b2722e28: Enable the blocker, then open the tests in Comfort mode. Compare blocked requests and hidden elements; scores vary with filter lists, tests and their scripts.
ui.leaktestshtml.texte718105277: Test a French news site and YouTube, then repeat after manually updating the lists with Tor connected.
ui.leaktestshtml.text0f56a77810: Expected result: the majority of common network tests covered by the filters should succeed; I don't give an honest target percentage without running every test in this version and its current lists. The three testers change and measure different things. Snapshot 0.4.0 contains EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock filters provided by Ghostery and Peter Lowe. The FR + EasyList list is activated in the settings but only downloaded on the first successful Tor update. Nacre does not guarantee the blocking of YouTube advertisements: Google is evolving ads and anti-adblock; the logged in account, ads served from the site domain and page changes may resist. Cosmetic filters/scriptlets can also break the video. Strict and custom filters can break other sites.
ui.leaktestshtml.text6dc53473f8: Test requests go to third-party testers via the configured route. Nacre does not send any result report.
ui.leaktestshtml.text8573c8bca9: This field is temporary; copy important results elsewhere if you want to keep them.
ui.leaktestshtml.texta45d7da1c3: Date, Tor mode, IP / DNS / WebRTC / Canvas / WebGL / fonts results…
ui.leaktestshtml.text2bf772f8dd: Connect Tor, load an HTTPS page, stop tor.exe and reload. Expected result: a Nacre error page or network failure, with no direct access. After reconnecting, the requested page can resume.
ui.leaktestshtml.text4fe66df589: With Tor connected, test browserleaks.com/dns. Resolvers should not reveal your ISP. Without Tor, Quad9 DoH is used by default, depending on the profile.
ui.leaktestshtml.textc2641466ce: browserleaks.com/webrtc should not show the real IP; RTCPeerConnection may exist. The policy blocks unproxied UDP. Also checks camera/microphone refused without authorization.
ui.leaktestshtml.text017a9a664b: Open a test site with an invalid certificate. Nacre should display an error without offering a bypass.
ui.leaktestshtml.texte0cdc27d0b: Open two private tabs on different domains; each must use separate SOCKS credentials. Close a tab, then use “New Identity”: Tor can create new circuits, but a different exit IP is not guaranteed.
ui.leaktestshtml.texta8f7a9c293: a site that requests a camera, microphone, geolocation or notifications must be refused by default. Check for an “Allow” exception, then reset it.
ui.leaktestshtml.text0aadc02197: With Tor stopped, updating should fail while keeping the active lists. It must never switch to a direct connection. Each list server receives the request through the Tor exit IP.
ui.leaktestshtml.text2c6cc56263: Close the last private tab, then reopen the same site. The temporary session should not reuse cookies or storage. Files you saved remain on disk.
ui.leaktestshtml.textc9a1495390: BrowserLeaks must confirm the status described in section WebGL above; this result remains to be verified on the current installation.
ui.leaktestshtml.text1d35ae4e7c: Choose obfs4 or Snowflake, connect Tor and check its status. If the bridge fails, Nacre should identify the transport and a likely cause. Pages must remain blocked without a direct route.
ui.leaktestshtml.texte8ad3f6e66: Checks are available only when Tor is connected. GitHub receives the requested repository name and Tor exit address, not your history, bookmarks, or visited URLs. Nothing downloads or installs automatically.
ui.leaktestshtml.textdb1d89278b: Add a bookmark, export it, then import a test file and confirm the result. Non-HTTP(S) URLs should be rejected.
ui.leaktestshtml.textff662872f0: Download a test file and check the sanitized filename and folder choice. An executable must require confirmation before downloading or opening. Nacre pages must not receive the absolute path.
ui.leaktestshtml.texta594232297: Enable the blocker, check its counter and add a site exception. Report a broken site and confirm that the report is copied locally without being sent.
ui.leaktestshtml.textd3f8c04f9e: Connect Tor, open an HTTPS page and wait for it to be displayed.
ui.leaktestshtml.text69e146cdd2: Reload: the page must fail and no direct connection must replace Tor.
ui.leaktestshtml.text33701a401b: A series of tests does not prove the general absence of leaks. Redo them after updating Nacre, Electron or Tor.
ui.offlinehtml.textbe0a4a3960: Remote web pages cannot be loaded. If navigation via Tor is enabled, Nacre voluntarily blocks traffic (kill switch active) without resorting to an unprotected direct connection.
ui.offlinehtml.textbaab8d78c0: Check the Internet connection of your Windows system.
ui.offlinehtml.textb4aae143bf: If Tor is used, try again from the Tor button as soon as the service is available.
ui.offlinehtml.texta017380072: Check that the configured proxy responds on its local port.
ui.shortcutshtml.text0009b96657: Reopen the last closed normal tab (temporary memory)
ui.shortcutshtml.text661ebf31fc: Development tools for the active tab
ui.shortcutshtml.text2636dec0ed: Print or save as PDF via Chromium
ui.shortcutshtml.text2e2ce25d06: Show or hide the bookmarks bar
ui.testshtml.textec4e473807: These third-party sites run their own tests and may receive your IP address, browser information and requests needed for testing. Nacre does not receive their results. Open them only if you agree to these requests.
ui.testshtml.text2f5713e61d: Activate Tor in Nacre then open the official test. It should indicate that the browser is using Tor. Also check the country presented by the geolocation site if it is important for your use.

settings.phishingGuardNote: Checks every navigation locally against heuristics and your own list. Nothing is sent to a server.
settings.phishingBlocklist: Blocked domains or URLs, one per line
settings.phishingBlocklistNote: A plain domain also blocks its subdomains. An entry with a path matches the start of the address. The list is stored locally and never uploaded.
settings.phishingHeuristicsNote: The built-in checks look for encoded domains, raw IP addresses, brand impersonation, risky TLDs, and login-style subdomains. They can miss a phishing page or flag a legitimate one. The local list is not updated automatically.
settings.memorySaverNote: Frees memory after the delay by closing the page in inactive tabs. They reload when you select them. Pinned and audible tabs are never suspended.
settings.memorySaverLimit: Suspension is a local memory trade-off: a reloaded page may lose scroll position, forms, and unsaved state.

customLanguage.instructions: How to translate: replace each text on the right of the colon with your language and keep the key on the left as it is. _name is the name shown in the language list. _locale is your language code (for example sw for Swahili or he for Hebrew); it sets number and date formats and right-to-left writing. Keep the {words in braces} exactly as they are. Texts you leave unchanged are shown as they are; texts you remove are shown in English. Save the file as UTF-8, then choose the language in Settings › Appearance. After editing the file again, choose another language and back.
